scripts.build: sh -ec 'echo "Validating CPI artifacts..."; FILE=$(find iflows -name "*.zip" | sort -V | tail -1); test -n "$FILE"; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); echo "Processing $FILE"; unzip -t "$FILE"; mkdir -p dist; cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME"; NEXUS_USER="admin"; echo "nexus_password set? ${nexus_password:+yes}"; echo "ARTIFACT_URL set? ${ARTIFACT_URL:+yes}"; test -n "$NEXUS_USER"; test -n "$nexus_password"; test -n "$ARTIFACT_URL"; echo "Uploading to Nexus..."; curl --fail --show-error --silent -u "$NEXUS_USER:$nexus_password" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME"; echo "Uploaded successfully"'
